description: How long each step took for people who reported their own cases, merged across sources and counted once each: the median, quarter and three-quarter days, month by month. Also who's still waiting, as counts, and reported I-140s by category and premium processing. Send office or consulate for one USCIS office or one consulate. Self-reported: say so when quoting it. Example: {"office":"SFV"}.

consulate.description: A consulate's slug, from the consulates list, for that consulate's figures alone. Example: mumbai.

office.description: A USCIS office's three-letter code, for that office's figures alone. Example: SFV.

name: get_timelines

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: What people reported about their own cases, merged across sources and counted once each: how long each step took, and who's still waiting. Self-reported.

asOf.description: The day the figures were worked out, as YYYY-MM-DD.

cases.description: Reported cases behind the figures, each person once.

approvedShare.description: The share of those approved, 0 to 1.

medianDays.description: The median days to a decision.

premium.description: Premium processing: with filing, after filing, yes, none or not given.

rfeShare.description: The share that got a request for evidence, 0 to 1.

windowDays.description: The window the figures cover, in days.

i140.description: All only: reported I-140s by category and premium processing.

from.description: The first day of the week, as YYYY-MM-DD.

steps.description: Approvals reported in the week, by step.

count.description: People who reported finishing it that week. Null when under 5.

through.description: The last day of the week, as YYYY-MM-DD.

lastWeek.description: All only: the approvals people reported in the newest week.

i140s.description: Of those, with an I-140 date or decision.

inSeveral.description: Of those, reported in more than one place.

offices.description: Employment-based I-485s by USCIS office, the most reported first.

people.description: Listed cases from every source, each person once.

sources.description: Where the cases were reported. A case in two places counts in each.

overview.description: All only: the merged list at a glance.

place.description: The office code or consulate slug asked for, or null for all.

scope.description: all: every reported case. office: one USCIS office. consulate: one consulate.

steps.description: Each step with enough cases for a figure.

items.description: How long one step took for the people who reported it.

allTime.description: Every case ever reported for the step.

before.description: The six months before the window, when both hold enough cases: which way the step is moving.

cases.description: Cases behind the figure, in its window.

medianDays.description: The median days the step took.

cases.description: Cases that finished the step that month.

medianDays.description: Their median days. Null when the month holds too few cases.

month.description: The month the step finished, as YYYY-MM.

p25Days.description: A quarter of cases took this many days or fewer.

p75Days.description: Three quarters took this many days or fewer.

stage.description: Its stage: h1b, pwd, perm, i140, i485 or consular.

verified.description: True when the figure counts only timelines PERM Tracker checked.

windowDays.description: The window this figure covers: 183 or 365 days. Null when even a year holds too few cases.

unreadable.description: The parts of this answer that couldn't be read just now, by field name. Each is null in this answer. An empty list means every part was read.

byStage.description: Where the people heard from are waiting, at the furthest step each reported.

heard.description: People heard from in that time.

heardFromDays.description: How far back someone's newest report may be and still count as waiting, in days.

lines.description: The same people by category and country. A line of fewer than 5 isn't listed.

counts.description: One count per stage, in byStage's order. Null where it's under 5.

waiting.description: Who's still waiting, as counts. Null for a place without enough cases.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Get the timelines people reported
